data.body: Released 0.14.0. Release commit c9159d2af47 (Gerrit 3164, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) is merged on main and tagged v0.14.0. Release workflow run 41152912994 succeeded on every job: authorize, build, wheel and sdist tests, publish to PyPI, create GitHub Release, publish to MCP Registry. PyPI JSON reports latest 0.14.0 with the wheel and sdist, and both files serve PEP 740 provenance (HTTP 200 from the integrity API). The GitHub latest release is v0.14.0 (not draft, not prerelease) with the wheel, sdist and SHA256SUMS. The MCP Registry lists io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.14.0 as isLatest.
